definition.name: Set Secondary Site Position
definition.description: Sets E/W, N/S, elevation and angle of a named non-current project site, rolling back if the current site or survey point changes.
definition.aiDescription: Sets E/W, N/S, elevation and angle of a named non-current project site, rolling back if the current site or survey point changes.
examples: copy the values to the mirror site
